notes.title: Personality Update
notes.notes:
Personality: Conflict Resolution

Adding personality to characters allows for friendships to be created between characters, but conflicts can also arise due to different personalities.

A conflict between characters occurs when the friendship value falls below -75. In this case, an event icon will appear with a picture of one of the characters in conflict.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/c8d11669d3ade562d2e66ec0668ac26c48c1dc32.png

By clicking on the icon, the game switches to the makeup room (so that the employees don't argue in front of the guests), and the conflict moderator (Yvonne or an assistant) will listen to the employees and decide what to do next.

The conflict moderator is Yvonne on weekdays during the first shift and on all other days outside of work hours if the assistant is not at work.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/4a73b42a3f25ca63d5ab72679b89aea429ed8601.pngYvonne during the first shift on weekdays.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/7910d1afbe6c4fb5c02d866a6794996ac82c244b.pngYvonne on the second or third shift (all days).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/70be2a4815fddad762f7ecb068a45a17adb3fed0.pngAssistant, if she is at work (on weekdays in the second or third shift and on weekends all three shifts).

The moderator will then listen to the arguments of both employees.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/7c6d0f55c9627ecdcfd640a9b0a6f99be437a9e0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/79f33d4e6bf299894a2f6d65808d9cc7f25367d3.png
After that there are three options:
- calm down the situation and continue with work
- send employee A home on the day(s) off
- send employee B home on the day(s) off

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/be4da41dbb93bab7526e8dcddfdbd64ef4b3a98d.png
By choosing the first option, both employees continue working, and the friendship value between them is set to -50. There are no changes to the work schedule, and the conflict could happen again very quickly if Yvonne does not change their work schedule.

In the other two cases, the selected employee immediately stops working and goes on a day(s) off. An employee who takes a day(s) off will have their work schedule completely cleared, and Yvonne will have to create a new work schedule on the first following workday.

In case the Player does not click on the conflict icon, the employees will resolve the conflict themselves by having employee B take the day(s) off. In this case, information about this will appear in the upper left corner of the screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/7ff3369ebac316093ce872515369e4e9abf766ee.png
We strongly recommend that you do not rely on the automatic resolution of conflicts, because it can easily happen that you are left without a single employee on shift at a certain moment.

The conflict icon is active for 60 minutes, and to make it easier to spot, it also has a flashlight, and in Settings, there is an option to switch the game to normal speed when a conflict occurs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/01b3747b22a80b0646b619aa4bfab3c49bacbb2d.png

In case an employee is on leave, Yvonne will have to create a new work schedule on the first working day, and a warning about this is visible on the main management menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/d552fa3e48779b6890d3f6a666a2bea2090d237f.png

The relationships between employees are calculated at the beginning of each shift and at the beginning of the party event. In addition, the possibility of conflict is also calculated for each shift, and if there is a possibility of conflict, "Skip Shift" is not allowed for that shift.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/6614d220078ae76dc182b15e37356d458a1ba83d.png

Personality: Traits

Traits are predefined for all employees except for 'work Ethic' which is defined by the employee's class and whether the employee has a primary or secondary job.

However, some traits are variable (shy, perversion, exhibitionism) and change during certain actions (topless dancing, booty calls, etc.).

Party events (Topless and Lingerie Night) also affect certain traits (shy decreases when girls perform topless).

Personality: Dancer Clothes

Until now, during a normal performance, dancers on the main stage danced fully clothed, and within the sofa area, the choice of clothing was random.

Now the clothing is determined by the dancer's personality. A shy dancer will dance fully clothed on both the main stage and the sofa zone, while a dancer who is not shy and is an exhibitionist will dance topless.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/0c53b983d4ee7356a11012b52efa93942527cb38.png
During party events (Topless and Lingerie Night), all dancers (as well as waitresses) perform topless, regardless of personality and traits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/d6f9530ac6d65f7e8fc4577e5088db0cb708c7b4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/c42fd7dfa8c548d1a9b854f04b547fb9e1de282d.png

notes.title: Lingerie Night, bugfix
notes.notes:
Changes:

 bugfix: continue Lingerie Night after midnight


Explanation:

The engine expected both parts of the facility to be running during the event: the café and the dance club. If the café is not running, the engine gets stuck in a deadlock and does not allow the work to continue (for Topless Night, the café is mandatory, so this has remained unchanged).

This has now been fixed and now the event can work with only one part of the facility (only the café for Topless Night or only the club for Lingerie Night) as well as with both parts at the same time.

notes.title: Official Release Date
notes.notes:
November 14, 2024

That's it! After months of very hard work and testing, we are proud to announce that the game will be ready for release on November 14th, 2024.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107311/edeab7e08a8e42aa4a40c74c5873fb8fe22e495b.jpg

Brothel Tycoon is a simulation game where you are in the role of Yvonne, a young entrepreneur who wants to turn a small cafe into a luxurious place for adult entertainment.

And right at the beginning, I warn you not to expect to finish the game in a few minutes. It takes hours and hours of gameplay to see all the possible combinations of staff and all the possible scenes that are included in the game.

Also, a dose of planning is required because female employees can do several different jobs. Choose carefully in which position you will put a certain employee, because not all are equally good at all jobs.

The game, especially in the beginning, is not easy and if you are not careful, you can very easily go bankrupt, and bankruptcy is: the end of the game.

EMPLOYEES

After Yvonne buys the cafe, it is necessary to find employees. This part starts with choosing the assistant (which is a kind of game AI) and after that you need to choose the waitresses for the cafe.

During the game, when conditions are met, Yvonne can expand her business by hiring female dancers and opening a dance club.

Further development of the business enables the employment of additional employees such as security guards, nurses, hookers and maids. 

MANAGEMENT

It is possible to determine working days and shifts for employees, hire new ones and give notice to existing ones.

In addition, the basic task is to determine the prices of the services offered by the facility (in the range from -50 to +50% of the base prices).

GAME ENGINE

Although the game engine is Ren'Py, this is not a visual novel. This game is a business simulation.

There are elements of a visual novel in the game, but they are in the function of management and the selection of further actions and tasks.

"LIVE MODE" AND SEXUAL EVENTS

In addition to the conversations between the game's characters (which is performed in the form of a visual novel), the game also has a "Live Mode" where the player follows the events in various parts of the facility (café, dance and/or night club) and has an insight into all the actions that the employees do.

It is possible to see the waitresses while they serve the guests, but it is also possible to see how the nurses conduct a medical examination or what they do in their free time.

Please note that all female employees, at some point, have the opportunity to have sex with guests. Assistants and waitresses can have casual sex (booty call) with guests in the maintenance room, dancers have a make-up room for that purpose, and hookers have their own sex rooms anyway, as this is their main activity. Maids can have casual sex with guests while cleaning the rooms.

PICTURE GALLERY

The game contains a gallery with all the images of sex scenes that can be seen in the game, with the fact that the images can only be seen after you see the scene live in the game. After that, you can see that scene again whenever you want.

In addition, please note that all sex scenes have more images made than those you see at a certain moment in the game, and the engine itself displays the image by random selection. This means that the sex scene of a certain employee with the same guest is not always the same because the images are shown randomly.

GAME CONTENT

In addition to Yvonne, the game has forty-seven active characters that you can hire and over forty non-playable characters that are guests in the facility, which brings us to a total of almost hundred different characters visible during the game.

It was necessary to make a lot of pictures for all these characters, so the number of pictures included in the game is close to 9000.

All pictures are made in HD resolution, ie 1920 x 1080 pixels.

The game has no videos or animations except for very short transitions for the needs of some events during the game.

As for audio, the game has basic background music, sounds that can be heard inside the object, and certain sound effects for some parts of the game.

In addition to all of the above, the game also contains twenty-four Steam achievements and includes over twenty Steam statistical data, as well as the ability to save the game to the Steam cloud.

CONTINUATION PLANS

Although the game already has enough material for hours and hours of entertainment (I would dare to say several days), we believe that there is room for additional upgrades.

In line with that, the plan is to have a Staff Expansion Pack (it will be free, don't worry) which will add a dozen new employees and the addition of new events that the player can arbitrarily choose and activate in the game.
